name: react-vite
description: React 18 + Vite SPA (no SSR) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + React Router + Zustand

notes.serverCode: An SPA has no server runtime — the backend axis owns server logic entirely. If the backend is a BaaS, the browser calls the SDK directly, so data-layer security (row-level policy) is the only boundary
notes.language: The default is TypeScript. Pick JavaScript and the type-standard slot is replaced by JSDoc conventions
